coinbase_message_ascii: The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
coinbase_output_note: The 50 BTC genesis coinbase output is unspendable: it was never added to the UTXO set by Bitcoin Core.

times_reference.quote: The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks
times_reference.masthead: The Times (London), front page, Saturday 3 January 2009
times_reference.byline: Story by Francis Elliott, Deputy Political Editor, headline "Chancellor Alistair Darling on brink of second bailout for banks".
times_reference.significance: Embedded by Satoshi in the genesis coinbase as both a timestamp (the block cannot pre-date that day’s paper) and a comment on the bank bailouts Bitcoin was a response to.
